issue_title: SaveUploadedFile fails when the destination directory already exists
issue_description: Saving an uploaded file into an existing destination directory can fail with an operation-not-permitted error. The helper creates the directory if needed and then changes its mode unconditionally, so a pre-existing directory may be chmoded even though the process does not own it. Existing directories should remain usable without a permission change.
error_log: SaveUploadedFile returned: chmod /tmp: operation not permitted
